newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips on profit-taking in pre-holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips on profit-taking in pre-holiday trade.

text.p: Nasdaq shares eased slightly in pre-holiday trading Friday as investors adjusted to the new milestone reached in the previous session.

The Nasdaq Composite Index lost 3.62 points or 0.26 percent to close unofficially at 1367.19. The Dow industrials slipped below the 7,000 benchmark, falling 33 points or 0.48 percent to an unofficial close of 6989. The long-bond gained 17/32 to yield 6.53 percent.

"We had a huge runover the last couple of days. It looks like 7,000 is a number that's going to be tested on both sides a few times before we see any major movement," one trader said. "At these levels, it's not unexpected to see some profit-taking before the long weekend," he said.
Traders also said slight weakness in Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp dragged down the technology sector, which weighed heavily on the Nasdaq index.

Intel lost 2-1/2 to 154-1/2 and Microsoft eased 2-1/8 to 97-7/8. Cascade Communications Corp also shed 2-1/16 to 32-5/16. Sigma Designs Inc, which designs encoding and decoding add-on cards for the personal computer market, dropped 2-15/16 or almost 35 percent to 6-1/16 after a dismal fourth quarter profit warning.
